name: Coastline Marine Service Center
summary: Marine service, rigging, custom aluminum and parts for boats around Kemah, Clear Lake and Galveston Bay.

hero.title: Trained technicians for your boat
hero.titleAccent: and the outboard on the back of it.
hero.lead: Our shop on Delesandri Lane handles maintenance, repair and warranty work, with certified techs for Yamaha, Suzuki, Evinrude and Mercury. Call us and we will get you in and out in an efficient and timely manner.

groups.title: Engine Service
groups.summary: Maintenance, repair and warranty work on boats and outboards by certified techs.
groups.intro: When you are invested in making sure your watercraft stays in great working order for years to come, you need knowledge and skill you can count on. Our technicians maintain and service your boat and outboard, and the shop is set up with the equipment and experience to get a boat in prime shape, whether the goal is fishing, cruising or tow sports.

services.title: Outboard Service
services.text: Service and repair on the outboard, carried out by techs certified by the engine makers we are set up for.
points: Certified for Yamaha, Suzuki, Evinrude and Mercury
Parts ordered in when they are not on the shelf

services.title: Boat Maintenance
services.text: Routine work that keeps a boat ready for the water, booked by phone or through a service appointment request.
points: Work on the boat and the engine in one visit
Come talk to us about how to best maintain your investment

services.title: Warranty Work
services.text: Warranty repairs on the engine lines our technicians are certified for, handled at our own service center.
points: A state of the art service center built for the work

groups.title: Mobile Service
groups.summary: Our service truck comes to your boat for the same hourly service cost as the shop.
groups.intro: Do not fight the traffic, trailer your boat or make the commute. Our mobile service truck can come to your boat storage, boat dock or home to service your watercraft, and all for the same hourly service cost as work done at the shop.

services.title: Mobile Service Call
services.text: We meet you where your boat is, at a dock, a storage yard or your driveway.
points: The same hourly service cost as the shop
Ask about mobile service when you call

groups.title: Rigging And Electronics
groups.summary: Rigging with the vendors and components we trust, and the electronics and accessories we are an authorized dealer for.
groups.intro: We pride ourselves on making sure that when it comes to your boat's rigging we use the best vendors and components to keep you on the water. We are an authorized dealer for the electronics, audio, shallow water anchors and trolling motors that go with that work, so the gear and the install come from the same place.

services.title: Rigging
services.text: Rigging work on your boat using the vendors and components we have picked to keep you on the water.
points: Rigging and accessory fitting in the same shop

services.title: Marine Electronics
services.text: Authorized dealer for Garmin, Lowrance and Simrad, so a new display or sounder is sold and fitted here.

services.title: Audio And Lighting
services.text: Authorized dealer for JL Audio, Wet Sounds and Plash Lights.

services.title: Shallow Water Gear
services.text: Authorized dealer for Power Pole shallow water anchors and Minn Kota trolling motors.

groups.title: Custom Aluminum
groups.summary: A high end custom aluminum shop that fabricates marine aluminum accessories in house.
groups.intro: We have a high end custom aluminum shop where we fabricate in house all marine aluminum accessories. The work runs under the same roof as the service side, so a fabricated piece and the rigging it needs are handled by the same crew.

services.title: Aluminum Fabrication
services.text: Marine aluminum accessories fabricated in house at our own aluminum shop.
points: Our products are shown on our custom aluminum website

groups.title: Parts
groups.summary: A wide selection of parts and accessories, with anything out of stock ordered in for you.
groups.intro: Whether you need repairs or maintenance, or you are looking to customize your boat, we carry a wide selection of parts and accessories so you can maintain your boat and make it your own. If we do not have it in stock, we are happy to order it for you.

services.title: Parts Counter
services.text: Our parts staff helps you find the right parts and accessories to keep your watercraft running in optimal condition.

services.title: Parts Request
services.text: Send us what you need and the parts staff tracks it down, then calls you back about it.
points: By phone, at the counter or by a parts request
Fitting handled by the service side

about.title: A Kemah service center behind a Seabrook boat dealership.
text: Coastline Marine was founded in 2008. We have a simple goal: Provide the Highest quality product and craftsmanship while maintaining superior customer satisfaction.

values.title: Certified techs
values.text: Our service center has certified techs for Yamaha, Suzuki, Evinrude and Mercury.

values.title: We come to you
values.text: Mobile service brings the truck to your dock, storage or home for the same hourly service cost.

values.title: In and out
values.text: Give us a call and we will get you in and out of the shop in an efficient and timely manner.

faqs.q: Can you service my boat where it is kept?
faqs.a: Yes. Our mobile service truck can come to your boat storage, boat dock or home, and the hourly service cost is the same as work done at the shop.

faqs.q: Which engines are your technicians certified for?
faqs.a: Our service center has certified techs for Yamaha, Suzuki, Evinrude and Mercury.
Call us at (281) 291-0101 and we will help you over the phone or set up an appointment, or send a service appointment request.

faqs.q: What if a part is not in stock?
faqs.a: If we do not have it in stock, we are happy to order it for you. Call, come in, or send us a parts request.
At 1008 Delesandri Ln in Kemah, open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM. The boat dealership is at 2321 NASA Road One in Seabrook.

facts.heading: Engine Brands We Are Certified For
Mobile Service
facts.text: Our mobile service truck comes to your boat storage, boat dock or home to service your watercraft, for the same hourly service cost as the shop.

facts.heading: Booking A Service Appointment
facts.text: A service appointment request asks for the make, model and year of the vessel, its HIN and hours, the service needed, the date you want and whether we have worked on the boat before.

facts.heading: Ordering Parts
facts.text: To get the parts you need, call (281) 291-0101, come on in, or send a parts request. Anything not in stock we are happy to order for you.

facts.heading: Our Boat Dealership
facts.text: New and pre-owned boat sales, trade-in valuations and boat financing are handled at Coastline Marine, 2321 NASA Road One, Seabrook, TX 77586, on the same phone number.

facts.heading: Service Areas
facts.text: We serve the Houston area, including Seabrook, Kemah, San Leon, Clear Lake, Pearland, Baytown, La Porte, Pasadena, League City, Texas City and Galveston. Other areas are available as well, so call us for more information.
